sentences.en: Sami and Layla's twentieth anniversary is just around the corner.
sentences.zh: 萨米和莱拉的二十周年纪念日即将来临。

sentences.en: Our company had the fortieth anniversary of its foundation.
sentences.zh: 我们公司迎来了建公司的四十周年纪念。

sentences.en: Today is our anniversary so let's make this a special dinner.
sentences.zh: 今天是我们的周年纪念，让我们把这个晚餐弄得特别一些。
